## Actual canvas comparison on source/runtime 213baf7c68cc8f2018da92c4746bb8287e8e486e

ui-evidence-profile: responsive-web

Exact source/runtimeA; immutable BASE59 canvas hash 0a48f029dec14ce30ea4e1b9eed91f275a88a52d418a53f269ab086ce1d996a6. Actual24/24 browser rows passed with native0, no retries: pointer caret4→4 through reveal/remask; value/input focus and keyboard range2–7 preserved. Baseline24/24 caret4→0. No credential/code submit, account registration/login/reset-completion or private session. Only eight real unique-unregistered reset prerequisites.

All24 resting copy/geometry/style, hover, actual-press and keyboard-focus snapshots have ZERO baseline→final metric deltas. Invalid snapshots have16 differences ONLY in immediate-blur input computed-borderColor; stable endpoint is NOT separately observed. Original values/rows are retained in comparison-metrics.json and invalid-transition-source-audit.json; no timing explanation is promoted to proof. Final24 fullpages were viewed by the delegate via six original-resolution contact sheets; the lead still must perform its own final eyes-on. Actual source PNGs stay unchanged, hashes in original-png-sha256.json. Generated pairs retain captured app pixels with numeric captions outside them.

Extent: a static match below means the observed selected-mode element presence/composition/copy. Exact scalar field measurements are in full-canvas-inventory.actual.json; this is not a claim that every inherited primitive value equals every inline canvas literal, nor a new dynamic acceptance claim for untouched surrounding controls. Hidden/conditional states are explicit.

### Existing primitive / literal disclosure

The reveal buttons are concrete canvas elements110/163/253 with data-link and inline offset4px; canvas line10 applies activeopacity.8 to them. Actual unchanged canonical PasswordField uses offsetauto and pressedopacity1 in every profile. Offset4px is a size literal that can follow the documented existing-primitive/canvas-defect route (code keeps primitive; disclose; next redraw); this is a rule interpretation, not a found exact ownerGO. Pressopacity is a real inherited state mismatch and is not automatically a colour/size-literal exception; independent reviewer judges applicability. Product reason for retaining current primitive styling: one shared existing PasswordField across both hosts while restoring already-approved EARS-38 caret behavior, no new press look or style scope.

Inherited label-to-input gap also remains transparent: actual10px in both phases versus canvas mkField margin7px; the existing researched FormItem gap2.5 is retained rather than introducing a per-host style change.
